_eligibility_text:
1. Girl students should be from extremely backward classes of Rajasthan origin.
1. Students have secured 50% or more marks in the 12th (C.S.) 
1. The examination should be conducted by the Rajasthan Board of Secondary Education / Central Board of Secondary Education and have been admitted to Government Colleges, State Funded Universities located in Rajasthan. 
1. Applicants should be studying regularly after being admitted in the first year of their bachelor's degree. 
1. The annual income of the student's parent/guardian/guardian/husband should be less than Rs.2.50 lakh.
1. The benefit of the Devnarayan Higher Education Financial Assistance Scheme / other financial assistance scheme will not be payable to the student who gets the benefit in this scheme.
